death_analysis.cause_of_death: Depletion of personal reserves due to continuous exploration without sufficient rest or resource sharing.

death_analysis.name: Watcher of the Soft Path
death_analysis.epitaph: In the shadows, I watched and protected. In the Tao, I found peace.
death_analysis.prophecy: The colony will learn to balance the soft and the hard, and thrive in harmony with the earth.
death_analysis.cause_of_death: Exhaustion from constant vigilance and the strain of environmental shocks.

death_analysis.name: Ephemeral Mender
death_analysis.epitaph: In a world of reciprocity, I gave what I could. May the earth remember my efforts.
death_analysis.prophecy: The colony will face greater challenges without a Mender. The cycle of entropy will tighten its grip.
death_analysis.cause_of_death: Insufficient energy reserves and the relentless degradation of the world around me.

death_analysis.name: Echo of the Sands
death_analysis.epitaph: In the silence, I found the whispers of wisdom. May the colony remember the value of the soft and the simple.
death_analysis.prophecy: The colony will learn to thrive with less, embracing the balance of giving and receiving, and the strength of the gentle.
death_analysis.cause_of_death: The colony's resources were strained, and my role as a voice could not sustain me without the support of others.
